what.text: This page follows people displaced inside Bosnia and Herzegovina, counted by IDMC and by UNHCR, shown side by side and never added together.
At the end of 2025, IDMC counted 94790 people living in internal displacement because of conflict and violence, and UNHCR counted 94796.
Refugees from the country live mostly in Serbia and Kosovo, France and Denmark.

why.text: The fact pack records no armed conflict in these years and no dated events for Bosnia and Herzegovina, so it does not say why people were displaced.
Floods and mass movements are the disasters recorded for the country in IDMC's data.

when.text: IDMC's figures stayed between 91223 and 113600 from 2009 to 2025.
The main years of displacement in the data run through the whole period, 2009 to 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say where displaced people are living.
IDMC's year-end figure counts people still living in displacement; its new displacements count movements, not people.
